summary: Owned bounded stack inventories with item definitions, optional equipment slots and atomic add/remove/equip/unequip operations.
useWhen: A game needs stackable item storage and optional equipment slots without inventing slot, capacity and swap bookkeeping.
limitations: Stores item IDs/counts and equipment-slot assignments only. Effects, stats, loot rolls, UI and persistence remain game-owned.
Capacity is measured in distinct item stacks; equipment items are stored outside the bag. No weight, grid shape, sockets, durability or transactions across inventories.
